root_idea.summary: The root centers on elevation, protuberance, or something raised above its surroundings.
root_idea.development: The evidence presents a possible development from a hump or protuberant back to elevated terrain and other raised or swelling forms. The affectionate sense is explained through the image of bending protectively over someone.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized noun citation form حَدَبٌ.

senses.definition: Elevated or high ground; high terrain.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression مِنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ, “from every elevated ground,” describing the raised terrain from which they emerge or descend.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become humpbacked; to rise or grow high, becoming protuberant or convex.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or body, and also of a thing that rises or becomes gibbous or convex.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be affectionate, favorable, kind, or devoted toward someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَيْهِ. A specified use describes a woman devoting herself to caring for her child or children after her husband’s death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repel from and defend someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of elevating or raising the back; also, making a thing gibbous or convex.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The convex-making sense is reported with a qualification that it is absent from one consulted lexical copy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render someone humpbacked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render someone affectionate, favorable, or kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative causative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cling or cleave to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of sand, to be or become curved or winding, or curved, winding, and long.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the form of sand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An elevated or swelling mass, including wind-heaped sand, scattered or heaped plants, elevated or rolling waves, and the rise, swell, or abundance of a torrent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are extended physical applications of the elevation or swelling notion beyond the Quranic ground sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slope in a declivity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A terrain term also compared with the raised forms of waves and sand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mark or swelling left on the skin, such as a weal or thickened welt caused by beating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical mark or swelling on the skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The intensity of winter cold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or intensified description of severe seasonal cold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain plant, identified in one report as نَصِيّ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant name, distinct from the terrain noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affectionate, favorable, or kind toward someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective used with عَلَى, as in being affectionate toward one’s brother.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land abounding in the plant called حَدَب.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive expression for plant-rich land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hump on the back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited headword is written with ذ in this entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A year of drought, barrenness, or dearth, especially severe drought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An indeclinable expression for a drought year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Humpbacked; having a prominent or protuberant back with a hollow or receding chest and belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine is حَدْبَاءُ and the plural is حُدْبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Humped, gibbous, or protuberant in descriptive applications: of a bier or elevated apparatus, a tract of sand, or a lean camel or beast whose hips and back bones protrude.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are descriptive applications of the physical shape adjective. In one poetic bier expression, the phrase may instead denote a distressing condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A difficult or distressing affair or state; substantively, vehemence, severity, hardship, or distress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a difficult affair or affairs and also as a substantive expression for severity or hardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a vein penetrating into or lying within the bone of the forearm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A severe, cold year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of a harsh year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quick driving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression describing rapid driving.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most affectionate, favorable, or kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative use describing relative affection or favor toward a group.
